title: Mexican Lamb Kebabs with Zesty Butter
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional lamb kebabs, served with a zesty butter sauce. Perfect for a festive dinner or outdoor gathering.

ingredients.name: Turkish kebab skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper. Add lamb cubes and toss to coat.
Thread lamb, onion, bell pepper, and garlic onto kebab skewers, leaving space between each piece.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Meanwhile, prepare zesty butter by mixing softened butter with 1 tablespoon lime juice and 1 minced garlic clove.
Brush zesty butter onto kebabs during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve kebabs hot with additional zesty butter on the side, if desired.
